name: Telluric-Brae

civilization.name: Ysolde Dominion
civilization.notes: Nomad fleets riding the thermal belts, at war over every kilowatt of harvest.

description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, an ancient meteor crater emerge like the bones of the planet.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking. Their beacons answer incoming ships in a hundred borrowed languages.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
